about_the_game: This is just a single planet demo with the starter loadout.  The full game continues from this planet on to others, allowing you to keep building your character out for maximum destruction.
detailed_description: This is just a single planet demo with the starter loadout.  The full game continues from this planet on to others, allowing you to keep building your character out for maximum destruction.
name: Saucers Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: SM 3.0+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Saucers is a rogue-lite top-down twin-stick arena style shooter featuring extensive weaponry and upgrade paths so that every run is unique. The further you get, the more weaponry you can stack up to devastating effect.
